text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin and I are in the middle of
training
when she has a small outburst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! How am I already out of
breath?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: レースの疲れが残ってる？
choice_data_list_en: Still feeling tired from the race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine, and I'm gonna run in the
next race
too, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I told you I'm fine! Let's get back to training.
choice_data_list_en: Maybe you should rest after all...

text_block_list.text:
All those back-to-back races have
clearly
exhausted her. I should rethink
her upcoming
schedule.
